description: Add or update a lead's social/profile link for a platform — upserts by platform, so re-adding the same platform (e.g. 'linkedin') overwrites its url/label instead of duplicating; this is also how you EDIT an existing entry. Stored in leads.social_urls, a jsonb array of {platform, url, label?} — use this tool rather than update_lead to change it, so one add can't clobber another entry already in the array. Required: lead_id, platform, url. Optional: label (free text, e.g. a headline or note). Returns the full updated social_urls array.

label.description: Optional free-text note, e.g. a headline or last-checked summary.

name: add_lead_social_url
